note: Proposed modelling choices (not facts about any institution). Edit with approval. Class applies to an open requirement (state unresolved). A requirement in state exception is always class 'blocked'. Fit-rule requirements are always class 'restructure'.

classes.standard: Routine documentation or records work the cooperative can complete with ordinary support
classes.specialist: Work needing specialist input, such as financial reconstruction or field boundary capture
classes.restructure: The request does not fit the product. Closed only by restructuring the request
classes.blocked: Evidence is stale or disputed. Needs an external renewal or an independent re-verification

governance.action: Hold the meeting, upload minutes, obtain chairman sign-off, then field verification

member_register.action: Reconcile the member register and verify identities

land_right.action: Record the land-use right with a field boundary capture

farming_history.action: Compile programme records for the required seasons

income_records.action: Reconstruct income from the records available

group_structure.action: Define the groups and their members

asset_inventory.action: Inventory the assets and have them field verified

environmental_baseline.action: Capture the baseline in the field (boundary and photographs)

project_definition.action: Define the project and its location

fit.action: Restructure the request to fit the product
